name: The Diplomat Beach Resort
insider_take: A glamorous oceanfront playground where Old Hollywood elegance meets modern luxury on a pristine stretch of sand between Miami and Fort Lauderdale.
whats_special: This iconic resort sits on 300 feet of private beach and features a stunning infinity pool that appears to merge with the Atlantic Ocean. The property is home to the famous Diplomat Prime steakhouse and boasts one of South Florida's most impressive spa facilities with 30 treatment rooms.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20+ for breathtaking panoramic views of both the ocean and Intracoastal Waterway – the sunsets from these rooms are absolutely spectacular.
dont_miss: The rooftop cocktail experience at Monkitail with 360-degree views, and take advantage of the complimentary beach shuttle to explore the vibrant Hollywood Beach Boardwalk, one of the last great American boardwalks featuring street performers, local eateries, and bike rentals.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct beach access
Multiple dining venues and extensive amenities
Spacious rooms with ocean and Intracoastal views
Large resort-style pool complex with cabanas
cons: Large resort size may feel crowded during peak periods
Premium pricing for beachfront location and amenities
